description: This file defines utility functions for filesystem operations such as directory and file creation, reading, writing, copying, moving, deletion, and listing directory contents. It provides an interface for common file I/O tasks in C, including detailed handling of directories and files, with comments explaining each method's purpose.

methods.name: mkdir_p
methods.description: Creates all directories in the specified path with given permissions.

methods.name: readFileContents
methods.description: Reads full contents of an ASCII file, caller must free returned memory.

methods.name: readFileContentsWithTrim
methods.description: Reads full contents of a file and trims trailing newline, caller must free returned memory.

methods.name: writeContentsToFileName
methods.description: Writes contents to the specified file, creating it if necessary, overwriting existing content.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies data from source to destination file stream.

methods.name: copyFileByPath
methods.description: Copies a file from source path to destination path.

methods.name: moveFile
methods.description: Moves a file from one path to another, working across filesystems.

methods.name: doesNonEmptyFileExist
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and has non-zero size.

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Lists directory contents, invoking handler for each file/directory found, supports recursion.

methods.name: deleteDirectory
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and all its contents.

methods.name: deleteDirHandler
methods.description: Handles deletion of individual files or directories as part of directory deletion process.

methods.name: copyDirectory
methods.description: Recursively copies a directory and its contents to a new location.

methods.name: createMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates a zero-length marker file at specified path.

ctags.name: directoryHandler
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const char * pathname,const char * dname,unsigned char dtype,void * private)
